admission.policy: Observation only. Existing owner limits remain independent; no live actors, quality settings or LOD are changed.

transfers.scope: Transfer counters, not current persistent-cache size or RAM/GPU residency.

contentRuntime.measurement: Owner activity counts include dying/corpse states until their owner recycles them; they are not rendered mesh counts. Cinematic preparation counts only busy unwarmed slots, so additional shader/visibility preparation may be unreported. Known owned entries exclude unreported static actors. Byte counters cover named CPU payloads only; estimates, reservations, downloads and unknowns are kept separate. No total-memory or supported-population claim.

limits: Only one-second totals cover all active frames; global per-frame p95 and >20.83ms counts cannot be recovered.
events/critical are complete only under the recorder trigger (>50ms interval/work/draw submission); sampled/retained-frame distributions are biased.
